# Kellogg School of Management

> Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University offers world-class MBA, EMBA, and Executive Education programs with a focus on leadership development, career management, and global business opportunities.

Kellogg is a premier business school offering multiple MBA formats (Full-Time, Evening & Weekend, Executive), specialized programs in data analytics, healthcare management, entrepreneurship, and family business, along with robust alumni networks and corporate recruitment partnerships. The school emphasizes experiential learning, global opportunities, and community engagement across its Chicago-area campuses.

## Key Topics

- Full-Time MBA
- Evening & Weekend MBA
- Executive MBA (EMBA)
- Master in Management
- Doctoral Program
- Career Management Center
- Data Analytics
- Entrepreneurship
- Healthcare Management
- Family Business
- Social Impact & Sustainability
- Global Opportunities
- Alumni Network
- Leadership Development
- Executive Education

## MBA Programs & Academics

- [Kellogg School of Management: Build Your Legacy](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu): Kellogg homepage showcasing MBA, EMBA, and Executive Education programs
- [The Experience | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/the-experience): Overview of Kellogg community, student testimonials, and MBA experience
- [Data Analytics at Kellogg | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/data-analytics): Program for Data Analytics at Kellogg (PDAK) and analytics curriculum
- [Entrepreneurship | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/academics-research/entrepreneurship): Entrepreneurship pathway, startup funding, and venture capital programs
- [Kellogg MBA in Healthcare Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/academics-research/healthcare-at-kellogg): Healthcare management MBA, medical leadership, and MD-MBA program
- [Family Business MBA | Kellogg School | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/academics-research/family-business): Family business focus, John L. Ward Center, and executive education programs
- [Social Impact + Sustainability at Kellogg | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/academics-research/social-impact-sustainability): Sustainability initiatives, Abrams Climate Academy, and impact investing

- [Career Management Center | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/the-experience/career): Career services, coaching, job search support, and alumni career resources
- [Global Opportunities](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/the-experience/global-opportunities): Study abroad, global courses, and international business programs at Kellogg
- [Community | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/the-experience/community): Kellogg's collaborative culture, diversity, inclusion, and student community
- [Campuses | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/the-experience/campuses): Kellogg campus locations, facilities, and learning environments
- [People | Kellogg School of Management](https://kellogg.northwestern.edu/the-experience/people): Profiles of Kellogg students, faculty, staff, and alumni community
